Where are the polling places?

The Election Polling Places application can be used by citizens to locate the polling place where ballots can be cast on a typical Election Day.


Election Polling Places Voter Registration Application

Advanced mail ballots can be dropped off in the secure drop box located at the west door of the Historic Courthouse- 205 W Central Ave, El Dorado, KS.

More to Know

A collection of maps and apps to access information about current elected officials, locate voting centers, and more.

Voting Precincts

Who are my candidates and          representatives?

The My Elected Representative app can be used by citizens to determine who represents them in elected offices.  The My Candidates app helps determine who is running for office for your districts.

My Elected Representative My Candidates

Can I vote early?

Yes. The Early Voting application can be used by citizens to learn how ballots can be cast before Election Day.

Early Voting Voter Registration Application

What else to know about Advance Voting in Person

Can I vote if I'm out of town?

Yes. Advance Ballots for the Primary Election may be delivered to the Butler County Clerk's Office or to any polling place on the day of the election.

The Election Polling Places application can by used to locate the polling places where Advance Ballots can be delivered on Election Day.

Election Polling Places  Advance Ballot Application

Permanent Advance Ballot Application

A calendar of dates at times important in the election.
